supporting_role: partially premixed combustion and mixing support

target_questions.question: Does natural-gas pre-injection provide model-resolved support for a mixing-mediated soot/CO tradeoff?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 A030 links timing/sequence to premixed versus mixing-controlled behavior; this study tests an additional natural-gas strategy.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: In the validated 3D model, natural-gas pre-injection increased premixing and reduced soot and CO, with pressure-rise and NOx tradeoffs dependent on pre-injection proportion, timing, and EGR.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Cell fields and species traces connect the pre-injection strategy to larger lean/high-OH regions and lower soot/CO formation.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: injection sequence controls premixed versus mixing-controlled combustion

limitations: Model-resolved engine evidence; the optimum depends on the modeled combustion mode and EGR setting.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
